orders.text:
AO No. 398 of 2010 
Hon’ble Tarun Agarwala, J.
Mr. Pankaj Purohit, Advocate for the 
appellant. 
Admit. 
Issue notice to the opposite party Nos. 1 
to 8 by registered post acknowledgment due. 
Steps to be taken within a week. 
List for orders after expiry of six weeks 
on the date fixed in the summons by which 
time the said respondents may file objection to 
the stay application, if any. 
Until further orders, the effect and 
operation of the award dated 27/07/2010 
passed by the Motor Accident Claim Tribunal/ 
Addl. District Judge, Rudrapur in Motor 
Accident Case No. 371 of 2008 shall remain 
stayed provided the appellant deposits the 
entire decreetal amount alongwith interest 
within six weeks from today before the 
Tribunal concerned after adjusting the amount 
already deposited before this Court. 50% of 
the decreetal amount can be withdrawn by the 
claimants without furnishing any security. The 
balance amount shall be kept in a fixed deposit 
so that it could earn interest and would be 
subject to the further orders of the Court. 
Registry is directed to remit the statutory 
amount deposited by the appellant before the 
Tribunal concerned within two weeks from 
today. 
 (Tarun Agarwala, J.) 
Dated 28.10.2010 
Shiv

13.11.2024 AO No. 398 of 2010
Hon’ble J.C.S. Rawat, J. (Retd.)
Mahesh Chandra Pant, Member
Mr. Shankar Aggarwal, Advocate for the 
appellant through video conferencing.
None present for the respondents.
The service report reveals that the 
address of the respondent no.7 is not complete 
hence the notices were returned. From the 
perusal of the record it is revealed that on the 
earlier occasion also the Hon’ble Court has 
effected on the respondent through publication.
 In these circumstances, it is not possible 
to proceed further in the Daily Lok Adalat in 
absence of the parties. Therefore, the matter be 
sent to the Hon’ble Court for final 
adjudication.
(Mahesh Chandra Pant, Member) (J.C.S.Rawat,J(Retd.)
